gap_definition: Demand or requisition returned repeatedly for incomplete justification, grade, location or role details
illustrative_detection_rule: Return/re-submit events >= 2 or missing required fields followed by return
intervention_options: Mandatory intake validation; role template; business-owner checklist

gap_definition: Budget or headcount validation remains pending beyond configured SLA
illustrative_detection_rule: Validation pending duration > SLA; evidence of queue timestamps
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Budget owner capacity or unclear approval routing
intervention_options: Escalation, delegated authority, queue ownership and planning integration

gap_definition: Approval queue delay or repeated approval returns
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Approver bottleneck or incomplete approval packet
intervention_options: Approval routing rules, completeness gates, aging alerts

gap_definition: Approved requisition waits too long for recruiter assignment
intervention_options: Load-balanced assignment; prioritization by role criticality

gap_definition: JD repeatedly revised or sourcing launch delayed after assignment
illustrative_detection_rule: JD revision loop or assignment-to-posting delay above SLA
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Role requirements not aligned at intake
intervention_options: Standard role profiles; intake calibration meeting

gap_definition: Shortlist remains in hiring-manager review queue beyond SLA
illustrative_detection_rule: Shortlist submitted, no decision event within SLA
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Competing priorities or unclear decision ownership
intervention_options: Decision SLA, delegate reviewer, aging dashboard and escalation

gap_definition: Screening decision delayed or applications repeatedly reviewed
illustrative_detection_rule: Receipt-to-decision exceeds SLA; repeated screening activity
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: High volume, unclear criteria or inconsistent triage
intervention_options: Structured screening rubric; queue segmentation; assisted triage with human review

gap_definition: Interview scheduling and rescheduling create excessive elapsed time
illustrative_detection_rule: Request-to-confirmation > SLA or reschedule count >= configured threshold
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Panel availability constraints or fragmented coordination
intervention_options: Panel capacity blocks; self-scheduling; consolidated interview windows

gap_definition: Feedback is late, incomplete or returned for clarification
illustrative_detection_rule: Feedback submission exceeds SLA or required fields missing
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Interviewers delay feedback or forms are unclear
intervention_options: Structured scorecards, reminders, feedback completeness gate

gap_definition: Assessment completion or result transfer is delayed/expired
illustrative_detection_rule: Assigned-to-complete exceeds SLA, expiry or sync lag
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Candidate friction, provider delay or integration issue
intervention_options: Clear due dates, reminders, provider SLA and integration monitoring

gap_definition: Decision waits after all required interviews/assessments or repeats
illustrative_detection_rule: Last required feedback available but no decision within SLA; repeated decision events
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Decision rights unclear or panel disagreement
intervention_options: Decision owner, calibration protocol, decision meeting cadence

gap_definition: Offer approval has long cycle time, revisions or repeated returns
illustrative_detection_rule: Proposal-to-approval > SLA or multiple revision/return events
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Compensation outside band, missing data or fragmented approval chain
intervention_options: Pre-approved bands, approval matrix, complete proposal validation

gap_definition: Offer is delayed after approval or has repeated negotiation/revision
illustrative_detection_rule: Approval-to-send delay or multiple negotiation events
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Expectation mismatch, slow communication or unclear offer positioning
intervention_options: Expectation alignment before offer; offer-generation automation; timely recruiter follow-up

gap_definition: Withdrawals cluster after long inactivity or specific stage delays
illustrative_detection_rule: Withdrawal preceded by inactivity/long wait; compare matched cohorts
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Candidate disengagement associated with process friction; causality not assumed
intervention_options: Stage-specific candidate communication and delay escalation

gap_definition: Verification or document collection delays joining readiness
illustrative_detection_rule: Acceptance-to-clearance/document completion > SLA or exception unresolved
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Late initiation, incomplete documentation or vendor delay
intervention_options: Start checks earlier where permitted; checklist; exception queue ownership

gap_definition: Cross-system handoff failure, synchronization lag or duplicate/manual update
illustrative_detection_rule: Integration error/retry or source-target lag; duplicate events reconciled
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Fragmented systems or weak integration monitoring
intervention_options: API/event integration, retry policy, reconciliation dashboard

gap_definition: Delay and manual follow-up correlate with high weighted recruiter load
illustrative_detection_rule: High weighted load plus aged queues; compare similar role/case mix
intervention_options: Weighted capacity planning, rebalance portfolio, surge support

gap_definition: Mandatory steps skipped, approvals missing or non-standard paths recur
illustrative_detection_rule: Missing mandatory event, invalid transition or policy version mismatch
rca_hypothesis_not_fact: Process configuration or governance not consistently embedded
intervention_options: Workflow guardrails, exception approval, policy-aware audit trail
